    • Instrument

      public Instrument(UUID instrumentId, String symbol, String instrumentName, String assetClass, String market, String currency, boolean isTradable)
      Constructs a new Instrument with the specified details.
      Parameters:
      instrumentId - the unique identifier of the instrument
      symbol - the trading symbol of the instrument
      instrumentName - the name of the instrument
      assetClass - the asset class of the instrument
      market - the market where the instrument is traded
      currency - the currency in which the instrument is traded
      isTradable - indicates whether the instrument is tradable
